name: Shirts and T-shirts
description: Shirt-like upper-body garments, including T-shirts, polo shirts, blouses, and button-front shirts. Excludes sweaters, sweatshirts, and jackets.

name: Sweaters and sweatshirts
description: Long-sleeved knit pullovers, sweaters, sweatshirts, and hoodies, excluding button-front shirts and structured outerwear.

name: Dresses
description: One-piece garments with a connected bodice and skirt extending below the waist.

name: Jackets
description: Front-opening outerwear with jacket construction, including structured collars, closures, and exterior pockets.

name: Sneakers
description: Enclosed casual or athletic shoes with sneaker construction and flexible rubber soles, excluding boots.

name: Boots
description: Footwear with boot construction and shafts reaching the ankle or higher, including lace-up and pull-on boots.

name: Sandals
description: Open footwear with exposed toes and strap-based uppers, including flip-flops.

name: Handbags
description: Handheld bags with a storage body and carrying handles or straps.

name: Pants and shorts
description: Lower-body garments with a waistband and two separate legs, including full-length trousers and shorts. Excludes skirts and dresses; unclear items remain in Other.

name: Bras
description: Bra-shaped upper-body garments with two cups connected by a chest band and shoulder straps. Excludes shirts, dresses, and other full-torso garments.

name: Skirts
description: Lower-body garments with a waistband and a single skirt section rather than two separate legs. Includes short and long skirts; excludes pants, shorts, and dresses. Unclear items remain in Other.
